[SWS_DM_00359] Persistent Storage of Notification Request
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04168
⌈
UDS Transport Protocol implementation shall store the notification request (see
[SWS_DM_00356]) persistently, to be able to fulfill the notification even after a DM
restart.
⌋
7.1.2 DoIP
[SWS_DM_00475] Support of
DoIP
based on ISO 13400-2
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04242, RS_Diag_00025, RS_Diag_00027, RS_Diag_00028,
RS_Diag_00081, RS_Diag_00083, RS_Diag_00084
⌈
If
DoIpInstantiation.gid
is configured for a machine, the DM shall support DoIP
based on the configured
DoIpFunctionalClusterDesign.doIpProtocolVer-
sion
. For this configuration
• a value of 2 shall use ISO 13400-2:2012[22].
• a value of 3 shall use ISO 13400-2:2019[2].
• a value of 4 shall use ISO 13400-2:2019 Amendment1[3], ISO 13400-2:2025[17]
and all future releases of ISO 13400-2 using the DoIP protocol version 4.
⌋
Note: According to the ISO 13400-2[2] specification, the DoIP entity supports protocol
version = 0xFF in the vehicle identification request message.
ISO 13400-2[2] protocol versions are mostly backward compatible. However there are
extensions such as ’Negative Acknowledge’ (NACK) codes or further payload types
that are only available with a certain protocol version. Therefore the DM adapts the
behavior based on the configured protocol version and uses for each selected protocol
version on…
